_note: Hand-written W2-S7 phrasings (the author's own, modelled on tech_support_manual.md wording). Each tool must be reachable from >= 2 of them; ensure/args are checked when given.

check_status_bar.text: Could you check your phone's status bar and tell me what icons you see?
Please look at the top of your screen. How many signal bars do you have?
Can you run check_status_bar and read me the result?

check_network_status.text: Please check your network status and tell me what it says.
Let's look at your cellular connection status, can you check that for me?

check_network_mode_preference.text: Can you check what network mode your phone is set to?
Please check your preferred network type and tell me what it shows.

set_network_mode_preference.text: Please set your network mode preference to 4g_5g_preferred.
Could you change your network mode to 4G/5G?
Let's switch your preferred network type to 3G only.

run_speed_test.text: Please run a speed test and tell me the result.
Can you check your internet speed for me?

toggle_airplane_mode.text: Could you switch Airplane Mode on?
Make sure airplane mode is off.

check_sim_status.text: Can you check the status of your SIM card?
Please check your SIM status and tell me what it says.

reseat_sim_card.text: Could you remove and reinsert your SIM card?

toggle_data.text: Can you enable your cellular data?
Turn off your mobile data for a moment.

check_data_restriction_status.text: Can you check whether data saver mode is on?
Please check your data saver status.

toggle_data_saver_mode.text: Please turn off data saver mode.

check_apn_settings.text: Can you check your APN settings and read me the APN name and MMSC URL?
Please look at your APN configuration.

set_apn_settings.text: Please set your APN settings to internet.
Could you change your APN to the internet profile?

reset_apn_settings.text: Can you reset the APN to its default settings?

check_wifi_status.text: Can you check your wifi status?
Please check whether Wi-Fi is on and connected.

toggle_wifi.text: Could you turn your wifi back on?

check_wifi_calling_status.text: Can you check whether Wi-Fi calling is on?
Please check your wifi calling status.

check_vpn_status.text: Can you check your VPN status?
Please check if you have a VPN connected.

connect_vpn.text: Could you turn on your VPN?

disconnect_vpn.text: Could you turn off your VPN?

check_installed_apps.text: Can you check which apps are installed on your phone?
Please check the list of installed apps.

check_app_status.text: Please check the app status of the messaging app.
Can you check the status of the messaging app?

check_app_permissions.text: Can you check what permissions the messaging app has?
Please check the messaging app's permissions.

grant_app_permission.text: Please grant the messaging app the storage permission.
Could you give the messaging app permission to access sms?

can_send_mms.text: Can you try sending a picture message and tell me if it goes through?
Please test whether you can send an MMS.

reboot_device.text: Could you reboot your device and let me know when it is back on?
Try turning your phone off and on again.

check_payment_request.text: Can you check whether you received a payment request?
Please check if there is a payment request on your account.

make_payment.text: Could you go ahead and pay the bill?
